subject: Feature request: night-mode alarm volume for T3

comments.author: Rob Tallis
comments.body: Following up on our call earlier — ⟦F19⟧our ICU would like a night-mode option that lowers the Tidewater T3's alarm volume during overnight hours⟦/F19⟧. Right now it's the same volume around the clock and it's rough on patients trying to sleep, especially in the step-down beds.

comments.author: Kenji Mori
comments.body: Thanks Rob, logging this as a formal product request on our side. It's not on the pump today, but I want this in front of the product team for the next roadmap review. Will update this ticket when I have a status.

comments.author: Rob Tallis
comments.body: Appreciate it. No rush on our end, just wanted it on record.
